title: 第3章 葬天神功第4章 叶倾城
content_zh:
轰！
苏尘的脑海中，一篇金色的经文，散发着不朽的光芒，缓缓浮现而出。
葬天神功！
“以诸天星辰为血，以诸天世界为体，以亿万神兵为骨，以无尽苍生为神……铸不灭之体，一吼神魔陨，一念混沌开，破灭万物，埋葬诸天……”
洪钟大吕一般的声音，在苏尘的脑海中响起。
那篇名为葬天神功的功法，深深的烙印在了他的脑海之中。
“葬天神功？破灭万物，埋葬诸天……这是何等逆天的功法？”
苏尘浑身震动，充满了难以置信的神色。
这种功法简直逆天到了极点。
苏尘感觉到，原本他整个人像是要被彻底的撕裂了，而在他参悟了葬天神功之后，神功自动运转，那些浩瀚的气血之力，宛如百川归流一般，涌入到他的体内。
他干涸的血脉在复苏。
他破碎的丹田在重塑。
他的肉身宛如脱胎换骨一般，发生了一种无比神秘的变化。
苏尘缓缓睁开双眼，眸子之中精芒璀璨，浑身都充满了无穷无尽的力量波动。
“我的血脉和丹田，恢复了？”
苏尘浑身震动，眼神中满是无比激动的神色。
昂！
一道古老而神秘的龙吟声响起，苏尘周身有一条金色的真龙环绕，看起来威严而尊贵。
他的丹田也已经恢复如初。
“为何感觉，我的天龙血脉不一样了？”

苏尘有些疑惑。
“你的杂龙血脉，有什么值得留恋的？你如今脱胎换骨，已经复苏了真龙血脉，未来若是寻到龙族神物，就算是继续进化，也不是不可能！”
白衣女子淡淡的说道。
“真龙血脉？”
苏尘瞪大了眼睛。
血脉之力分为：人、地、天、王、圣、帝、神，总共七阶。
苏尘之前的天龙血脉，乃是天阶血脉，就已经是整个大罗王朝最顶尖的血脉了，而真龙血脉，乃是传说之中的圣级血脉。
这葬天古戒到底是何等宝物？
竟然能够让他脱胎换骨，拥有如此逆天的资质！
“葬天古戒的来历，不是你现在能够知道的！
你只需要知道，你是葬天古戒的主人，而这诸天万界，总共有九枚葬天古戒，其中封印着九大葬天界的碎片，每一块碎片之上，都封印着一尊绝世凶魔的部分尸体！
如今这枚葬天古戒之中的力量耗损严重，已经很难封印那尊绝世凶魔的尸体了！
你要做的，就是努力提升修为，寻找其他九枚葬天古戒，合九大葬天古戒的力量，才能够镇压绝世凶魔！”
白衣女子，仿佛看出了苏尘心中的疑惑，缓缓说道。
content_en:
boom!
In Su Chen's mind, a golden scripture, exuding immortal light, slowly emerged.
Burial of Heaven Divine Art!
"Use the stars in the sky as blood, the world in the heavens as the body, billions of divine soldiers as bones, and endless people as gods... Forge an indestructible body. With a roar, gods and demons will fall, with a thought, chaos will open, destroy all things, and bury the heavens..."
A voice like a bell sounded in Su Chen's mind.
That article called the Heaven Burial Divine Technique was deeply imprinted in his mind.
"The divine art of burying the heavens? Destroy all things and bury the heavens... What kind of heaven-defying art is this?"
Su Chen's whole body was shaken, full of disbelief.
This kind of skill is simply unbelievable to the extreme.
Su Chen felt that his whole body was about to be completely torn apart, but after he comprehended the Heaven Burying Divine Art, the divine art started to operate automatically, and the vast power of Qi and blood poured into his body like hundreds of rivers flowing back.
His dried blood was reviving.
His broken Dantian is being reshaped.
His physical body seemed to have been completely reborn, undergoing an extremely mysterious change.
Su Chen slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were shining brightly, and his whole body was filled with endless power fluctuations.
"My blood and Dantian have recovered?"
Su Chen was shaken all over, and his eyes were full of excitement.
hold head high!
An ancient and mysterious dragon roar sounded, and Su Chen was surrounded by a golden dragon, looking majestic and noble.
His Dantian has also returned to its original state.
"Why do you feel that my Tianlong bloodline is different?"
Su Chen was a little confused.
"What is there to miss about your miscellaneous dragon bloodline? Now that you have been reborn, you have revived your true dragon bloodline. If you find dragon artifacts in the future, even if you continue to evolve, it is not impossible!"
The woman in white said calmly.
"True dragon bloodline?"
Su Chen's eyes widened.
The power of blood is divided into seven levels: human, earth, heaven, king, saint, emperor, and god.
Su Chen's previous Tianlong bloodline was a heaven-level bloodline, which was already the top bloodline in the entire Daluo Dynasty, while the True Dragon bloodline was a legendary holy-level bloodline.
What kind of treasure is this ancient burial ring?
It was able to transform him into a new person, with such incredible qualifications!
"The origin of the Ancient Burial Ring is not something you can know now!
All you need to know is that you are the master of the Ancient Burying Heaven Ring, and there are a total of nine Ancient Burying Heaven Rings in all the worlds, among which are fragments of the nine great Burying Heaven Realms sealed, and on each fragment is sealed a part of the corpse of a peerless evil demon!
Now that the power in this ancient ring of burial is severely depleted, it is already difficult to seal the body of that peerless evil demon!
What you have to do is to work hard to improve your cultivation, find the other nine ancient burial rings, and combine the power of the nine ancient burial rings to suppress the peerless evil! "
The woman in white seemed to see the doubts in Su Chen's heart and said slowly.
